comments.body: This bug is still active with the July 2024 version.

Related/duplicate issue: https://github.com/microsoft/DirectXShaderCompiler/issues/7322

If `//Texture2D testTexture;` is commented out `testVariable` is recognized only by its unqualified name. Uncommenting the texture declaration makes it recognizable by the qualified name as well. Definitely a bug.

title: Variable inside a namespace not found
